## Linear Models

# total aboveground biomass
m_sum_agb <- lm(total_agb~ treatment * beetle,
                data = df_summer)
summary(m_sum_agb) # * No sig relationship
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = total_agb ~ treatment * beetle, data = df_summer)

## F-statistic: 3.066 on 3 and 54 DF,  p-value: 0.0356

## Generalized Linear Mixed-Effects Model, poisson vs negative binom

# pod count
m_s_pod_num_pois <- glm(pod_num ~ treatment * beetle,
                     data = df_summer,
                     family = poisson)
m_f_pod_num_pois <- glm(pod_num ~ treatment * beetle,
                         data = df_fall,
                         family = poisson)

performance::check_overdispersion(m_s_pod_num_pois) # overdispersed 
## # Overdispersion test
## 
##        dispersion ratio =   2.526
##   Pearson's Chi-Squared = 136.393
##                 p-value = < 0.001
## Overdispersion detected.
performance::check_overdispersion(m_f_pod_num_pois) # NOT overdispersed
## # Overdispersion test
## 
##        dispersion ratio =  1.259
##   Pearson's Chi-Squared = 47.857
##                 p-value =  0.131
## No overdispersion detected.
m_s_pod_num_nb <- MASS::glm.nb(pod_num ~ treatment * beetle,
                        data = df_summer)

summary(m_s_pod_num_nb) # No significant effect
## 
## Call:
## MASS::glm.nb(formula = pod_num ~ treatment * beetle, data = df_summer, 
##     init.theta = 26.20625443, link = log)
## 
## Coefficients:
##                                        Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)    
## (Intercept)                             3.94884    0.08473  46.604   <2e-16 ***
## treatmentMicroplastic,                  0.06077    0.11923   0.510    0.610    
## beetleNo Beetle                        -0.14854    0.10031  -1.481    0.139    
## treatmentMicroplastic,:beetleNo Beetle  0.12881    0.14070   0.915    0.360    
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## (Dispersion parameter for Negative Binomial(26.2063) family taken to be 1)
## 
##     Null deviance: 76.029  on 57  degrees of freedom
## Residual deviance: 68.024  on 54  degrees of freedom
## AIC: 471.36
## 
## Number of Fisher Scoring iterations: 1
## 
## 
##               Theta:  26.21 
##           Std. Err.:  8.48 
## 
##  2 x log-likelihood:  -461.365
summary(m_f_pod_num_pois) # *** Treatment: p= 2e-16, slope = 0.4139
## 
## Call:
## glm(formula = pod_num ~ treatment * beetle, family = poisson, 
##     data = df_fall)
## 
## Coefficients:
##                                        Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)    
## (Intercept)                             3.38439    0.06509  51.992  < 2e-16 ***

## beetleNo Beetle                        -0.06046    0.08371  -0.722    0.470

## ---

# seed count

                        data = df_summer,
                        family = poisson)

                        data = df_fall,
                        family = poisson)

performance::check_overdispersion(m_s_seed_num_pois) # overdispersed

##   Pearson's Chi-Squared = 243.941

##   Pearson's Chi-Squared = 108.767

## Visualization

# Aboveground biomass
sum_agb <- df_summer %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = treatment,
             y = total_agb,
             color = beetle)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Treatment",
       y = "Total Aboveground Biomass (g)",
       title = "Summer 2025 AGB",
       color = "Beetle Present")

fall_agb <- df_fall %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = treatment,
             y = total_agb,
             color = beetle)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Treatment",
       y = "Total Aboveground Biomass (g)",
       title = "Fall 2025 AGB",
       color = "Beetle Present")

sum_agb + fall_agb
